name: x402.org testnet facilitator
description: Public x402 facilitator for testnets: verifies and settles x402 exact-scheme USDC payments on Base Sepolia so sellers need no chain node.

name: Coinbase CDP x402 facilitator
description: Hosted x402 facilitator from Coinbase Developer Platform: free verify, settle USDC payments on Base with OFAC/KYT screening; first 1,000 tx/month free.

name: x402 Bazaar discovery API
description: Public discovery endpoint listing x402-payable resources indexed after settled payments; search returns up to 20 results ranked by relevance and quality.

name: x402 Bazaar listing validator
description: Free validation endpoint to check x402 resource metadata before it is indexed by Bazaar.

name: Agentic Market services API
description: Public catalogue API of agent-payable services with a search endpoint and llms.txt; lists thousands of paid services for agents.

name: Official MCP Registry API
description: Metadata-only public registry of MCP servers with search; entries include remote streamable-http URLs and packages. Built for aggregators.

name: GitHub MCP Server
description: GitHub's official MCP server: lets agents read repositories, manage issues and pull requests, and inspect workflows and code.

name: Playwright MCP
description: Microsoft MCP server that gives agents browser automation via Playwright using accessibility snapshots: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots.

name: Stripe MCP server
description: Stripe's remote MCP server exposing Stripe API tools (customers, payments, invoices, products) and documentation search to agents.

name: Sentry MCP server
description: Remote MCP server from Sentry for querying errors, issues, stack traces and projects to help agents debug production problems.

name: Linear MCP server
description: Linear's remote MCP server to find, create and update issues, projects and comments in Linear.

name: Notion MCP server
description: Notion's hosted MCP server letting agents search, read and edit Notion pages and databases.

name: Cloudflare documentation MCP server
description: Cloudflare-hosted remote MCP server for searching Cloudflare developer documentation (Workers, R2, D1, etc).

name: MCP Filesystem server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server for secure local file operations with configurable allowed directories: read, write, list, search files.

name: MCP Fetch server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server that fetches web pages and converts HTML to markdown for efficient LLM consumption.

name: MCP Git server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server with tools to read, search and manipulate local Git repositories (status, diff, log, commit).

name: MCP Memory server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server providing persistent memory as a local knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations.

name: MCP Time server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server for current time and timezone conversion using IANA timezone names.

name: MCP Sequential Thinking server (reference)
description: Reference MCP server that supports dynamic, reflective step-by-step problem solving through thought sequences.

name: npm registry API
description: Public JSON API for npm package metadata: versions, dependencies, maintainers; plus a changes feed for replication.

name: npm downloads API
description: Public API returning download counts for npm packages over a period, useful as a popularity signal.

name: PyPI JSON API
description: Public JSON API for Python package metadata per project and release at /pypi/<project>/json.

name: deps.dev API
description: Google Open Source Insights API: package versions, dependency graphs, licences and advisories across npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo, NuGet.

name: OSV vulnerability API
description: Open Source Vulnerabilities database API: query known vulnerabilities by package and version or commit.

name: GitHub REST API
description: GitHub REST API for repositories, issues, pull requests, releases and search; rate-limited 60/h unauthenticated, 5,000/h authenticated.

name: Wikidata SPARQL endpoint
description: Public SPARQL query service over CC0 Wikidata structured data: entities, software, organisations, websites.

name: Base Sepolia public RPC
description: Public JSON-RPC endpoint for the Base Sepolia testnet (chain id 84532), rate-limited, for development use.

name: Circle testnet USDC faucet
description: Circle faucet dispensing testnet USDC on Base Sepolia and other testnets for development.

name: x402 TypeScript SDK (npm x402)
description: Reference TypeScript library for x402: payment payload types, exact scheme for EVM, facilitator client to verify and settle.

name: x402-express middleware
description: Express middleware that returns 402 Payment Required and verifies/settles x402 payments per route.

name: pgvector
description: Open-source Postgres extension for vector similarity search: exact and approximate (HNSW, IVFFlat) nearest neighbour, halfvec and bit types.
